name: County of Orange Mortgage Assistance Program (MAP)
administrator: County of Orange (OC Housing & Community Development); processed by Affordable Housing Clearinghouse (nonprofit agent)
amount: Up to $80,000, not to exceed 20% of purchase price
term: 30 years; principal and interest deferred, due in year 30 or on sale, transfer, non-occupancy, or refinance/payoff of the first mortgage
firstTimeBuyer: Required for all buyers on title (no ownership in prior 3 years; exceptions for displaced homemakers, single parents, mobile-home-only owners)
priceLimit: Sales price no more than 85% of the Orange County median sales price for all homes (dollar figure not published; ask the Clearinghouse)
eligibleAreas: Unincorporated OC plus Brea, Cypress, Dana Point, La Palma, Laguna Beach, Laguna Hills, Laguna Woods, Los Alamitos, Placentia, San Juan Capistrano, Seal Beach, Stanton, Villa Park, Yorba Linda
otherRules: Minimum 1% buyer contribution; 8-hour education through the Clearinghouse (certificate dated within 12 months); fixed-rate 30-year first mortgage from a participating lender; impounds required; combined LTV no more than 100%; no minimum credit score; US citizen or permanent resident; $33.50 application fee
howToApply: Contact Affordable Housing Clearinghouse, (949) 859-9255, 23201 Lake Center Dr #203, Lake Forest; submit the MAP eligibility form, affidavit, and borrower certification. County contact: Sherluna Vien, (714) 480-2936
statusDetail: Clearinghouse page heading says MAP 'is now open and accepting Applications' (undated). The same URL appears in search indexes titled 'NOTICE: Program Currently Closed'. The county page gives no status. The application package is dated 5/5/2026. Call to confirm.
machineReadable: County page: HTML (fetchable). Terms: text-layer PDF (pdftotext works). Clearinghouse page: HTML.
